page.overview:
What is Dusknoir?

Dusknoir is a Pokémon who came from the future in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time, Darkness, and Sky. Early in the story, he is thought of as a friend and even a celebrity, but he is later revealed to have been deceiving everyone. In reality, he was an agent of Primal Dialga, sent to the past to capture the protagonist and Grovyle to stop them from altering history and preventing the planet's paralysis.

Dusknoir is shown to be a character with a very strong sense of self-preservation. Believing Dialga to be the most powerful Pokémon, he surrenders himself to Dialga's will. Moreover, he is particularly ardent in the defense of the dark future because he will cease to exist if history is altered.

Dusknoir came from the future in order to capture Grovyle and the Player, who had traveled back in time to prevent the planet from becoming paralyzed. He used the knowledge of the future to quickly become a famous explorer revered for his wisdom. He is first met when he comes to Wigglytuff's guild to inquire about the expedition of Fogbound Lake. Wigglytuff lies to him that the expedition was a failure to keep the guild's promise to Uxie. Dusknoir decides to stay in Treasure Town for a while.

When the Player and Partner leave to retrieve the Water Float that Team Skull stole from Amp Plains, Dusknoir learns at Kecleon Market about the theft and leaves in a hurry as soon as he hears it. At Amp Plains, when Luxray/Manectric prepares to attack the Player and Partner with a large electric blast, Dusknoir intervenes and blocks the attack and calms down the electric tribe. Dusknoir explains to the Player and Partner that the electric tribe is hostile to trespassers after they were attacked in the past and drives off Team Skull, the ones responsible for the misunderstanding. Team Skull, who would have otherwise obliterated the player's team, is deterred by Dusknoir's presence and flees.
